verdict.rationale: Pointing an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for a documentation framework, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documented llms.txt generation or agent-oriented docs feature. Probes found no llms.txt (HTTP 404) and no markdown docs endpoint (docs.md, HTTP 404) on the official site. Static HTML output, MDX authoring and a plugin architecture are general building blocks and adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
